 See what the stars have in store for your sign By Snehaa Khanna Sahgal 15 November 2026 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) There may be a sense of disappointment you may be dealing with, Scorpio , and this disappointment is not here to take things away. If you observe closely, it is only here to show you what has not been working out for you, what you expected from life vs what you actually received or are receiving. And really, it is this subtly known state of imbalance that is making you feel like all is lost. It isn't. There is something on your mind that is pushing you towards a new creation—it's almost like you are pregnant with a new idea. Groom yourself to welcome this baby into your life, even if it isn't the exact thing you asked for. It will be worth it.
 Cosmic tip: Patiently water your garden.
